disclaimer: RESEARCH ONLY. NOT an operational warning system. Does NOT replace NWS tornado warnings.

audit_guarantees.label_time_axis: absolute UTC instants: SPC local time + tz offset (tz=3 CST -> +6 h); ProbSevere validTime UTC; reports from the observation's UTC day and the next
audit_guarantees.hrrr_analysis_matching: latest 3-hourly analysis at or before each observation, <= 3 h old; storms without one excluded
audit_guarantees.hrrr_grid_geometry: g2: native Lambert points binned by true lat/lon
audit_guarantees.negative_downsampling: train only, 5:1; val and test are full storm-object populations
audit_guarantees.probabilities: Platt-calibrated on the full validation population
audit_guarantees.torsion: (S_01 x grad tau).k / 25.0 -- tilting of low-level horizontal vorticity by the coherence gradient
